name: BiheytingAlgebra.toHeytingAlgebra
typeText: {α : Type u_4} → [self : BiheytingAlgebra.{u_4} α] → HeytingAlgebra.{u_4} α

source.code:
class BiheytingAlgebra (α : Type*) extends HeytingAlgebra α, SDiff α, HNot α where
  /-- `(· \ a)` is left adjoint to `(· ⊔ a)` -/
  sdiff_le_iff (a b c : α) : a \ b ≤ c ↔ a ≤ b ⊔ c
  /-- `⊤ \ a` is `￢a` -/
  top_sdiff (a : α) : ⊤ \ a = ￢a
